name: CRM (Customer Relationship Management)
summary: Zentrale Verwaltung von Kontakten, Firmen und Verkaufschancen mit Pipeline, Aktivitäten, Aufgaben und Auswertungen für ein Vertriebsteam.

roles.name: Administrator
roles.can: alles, inkl. Benutzer, Rollen, Pipelines, Felder und Einstellungen

roles.name: Vertriebsleiter
roles.can: alle Datensätze des eigenen Teams sehen und bearbeiten, Berichte, Ziele

roles.name: Vertriebsmitarbeiter
roles.can: eigene und freigegebene Datensätze sehen und bearbeiten

modules.name: Anmeldung & Benutzer
features: Admin lädt Benutzer ein und vergibt Rollen

criteria.title: Login with valid credentials lands on /dashboard
steps: Fill e-mail and password of an existing user

criteria.title: Login with a wrong password shows 'E-Mail oder Passwort falsch'
steps: Fill a registered e-mail and a wrong password
expected: Text 'E-Mail oder Passwort falsch' is visible

criteria.title: Unauthenticated access to /contacts redirects to /login
Admin invites a user with role 'Vertrieb' who can then log in
steps: Open the invitation link from the e-mail outbox and set a password
expected: New user appears in the user list with role 'Vertrieb'
The new user can log in

modules.name: Kontakte
features: Liste mit Suche, Filter (Firma, Besitzer, Tag) und Sortierung

criteria.title: Created contact appears in the list and opens its detail page
steps: Fill first name, last name, e-mail
expected: Clicking it opens /contacts/<id> showing the e-mail

criteria.title: Contact with an e-mail that already exists shows 'Kontakt mit dieser E-Mail existiert bereits'
steps: Create a contact with e-mail x@example.com
Create another contact with the same e-mail
expected: Text 'Kontakt mit dieser E-Mail existiert bereits' is visible
Only one contact with that e-mail exists

criteria.title: Searching and filtering by tag narrows the contact list
steps: Create two contacts, tag only one with 'VIP'
Search by the other contact's last name
expected: Tag filter shows only the tagged contact
Search shows only the matching contact

criteria.title: Edited contact keeps changes after reload
expected: New phone number is shown after reload

criteria.title: GET /api/contacts without a session returns 401

modules.name: Firmen
features: Firmenseite mit Kontakten, Deals und Aktivitäten

criteria.title: Contact assigned to a company is listed on the company page
steps: Create a contact and choose company 'Muster GmbH'

criteria.title: Company page shows open deals with their total value
steps: Create two open deals of 1000 and 2500 for the company

modules.name: Deals & Pipeline
features: Deals mit Wert, Phase, Wahrscheinlichkeit und erwartetem Abschlussdatum
Kanban-Pipeline mit Drag & Drop zwischen Phasen
Standardphasen: Qualifiziert, Angebot, Verhandlung, Gewonnen, Verloren

criteria.title: New deal appears in the first pipeline stage with its value
steps: Fill title 'Website-Relaunch', value 12000, choose a contact

criteria.title: Dragging a deal to another stage persists after reload
expected: Card is in column 'Angebot' after reload

criteria.title: Marking a deal as lost requires a reason
steps: Enter reason 'Preis zu hoch' and confirm
expected: Text 'Bitte einen Grund angeben' is visible on the first attempt
Deal status is 'Verloren' with reason 'Preis zu hoch'

criteria.title: Won deal leaves the open pipeline and counts as won revenue
expected: Deal is no longer in an open column

modules.name: Aktivitäten & Aufgaben
features: Anrufe, Meetings, E-Mails und Notizen protokollieren
Chronologische Timeline auf Kontakt, Firma und Deal

criteria.title: Logged call appears at the top of the contact timeline
Overdue task is highlighted in 'Meine Aufgaben'
steps: Create a task due yesterday assigned to me

criteria.title: Completing a task removes it from open tasks
steps: Tick the checkbox of an open task
expected: Task is no longer listed under open tasks after reload

modules.name: Globale Suche
features: Eine Suche über Kontakte, Firmen und Deals

criteria.title: Global search finds contact, company and deal by name
steps: Create contact 'Lena Berg', company 'Bergwerk AG', deal 'Berg-Projekt'
expected: Results show the contact, the company and the deal in separate groups

modules.name: Dashboard
features: Kennzahlen: offenes Pipeline-Volumen, gewonnen diesen Monat, Abschlussquote, fällige Aufgaben

criteria.title: Dashboard shows the open pipeline value as the sum of open deals
Sales rep does not see contacts owned by another rep
steps: As rep A create contact 'Geheim Kunde'
Log in as rep B (same role, other owner)

criteria.title: Rep B reading or editing rep A's contact via the API gets 404
steps: As rep B GET /api/contacts/<id of rep A's contact>
As rep B PATCH the same contact

criteria.title: Manager sees deals of every rep in the team
steps: Reps A and B of team 'Nord' each create a deal
Log in as the manager of team 'Nord'

modules.name: Leads & Konvertierung
features: Leads mit Status (Neu, Kontaktiert, Qualifiziert, Disqualifiziert)
Lead in Kontakt + Firma + Deal konvertieren

criteria.title: Converting a lead creates contact, company and deal and marks the lead converted
expected: Contact 'Max Hof' and company 'Hof KG' exist
A deal of 3.000 exists in the first stage

criteria.title: Public lead form submission creates a lead with source 'Webformular'
steps: POST the public lead form endpoint with name and e-mail
expected: Lead list contains the lead with source 'Webformular'

modules.name: Import & Export
features: Duplikate beim Import überspringen oder aktualisieren
Export der gefilterten Liste als CSV

criteria.title: CSV import with column mapping creates contacts and skips duplicates
steps: Upload a CSV with 3 rows, one with an existing e-mail
Choose 'Duplikate überspringen' and start the import

criteria.title: Export downloads the filtered contacts as CSV
expected: It contains exactly the filtered contacts with a header row

modules.name: Benutzerdefinierte Felder
features: Admin legt Felder für Kontakte, Firmen und Deals an (Text, Zahl, Datum, Auswahl)

criteria.title: Custom select field appears on the contact form and is saved
steps: As admin add field 'Branche' (select: Handel, IT) for contacts

criteria.title: Win-rate report per rep matches won and lost deals in the period
steps: Rep A wins 3 deals and loses 1 this month

criteria.title: Weighted forecast equals the sum of value × stage probability

modules.name: E-Mail aus dem CRM
features: E-Mail an Kontakte senden, automatisch in der Timeline protokolliert

criteria.title: E-mail sent from a contact uses the template placeholder and is logged
steps: Open contact 'Lena Berg', click 'E-Mail senden', choose the template, send
expected: Outbox contains a mail to the contact starting with 'Hallo Lena'

modules.name: Produkte & Angebote
features: Angebot als PDF mit fortlaufender Nummer

criteria.title: Adding products to a deal sets the deal value to the line total
Generated quote PDF has a sequential number
steps: Create two quotes via the API
expected: Second quote number is the first + 1

criteria.title: Assigning a deal to another user creates a notification for them
steps: As manager assign a deal to rep B

modules.name: Änderungsverlauf & DSGVO
features: Auskunft: alle Daten eines Kontakts exportieren

criteria.title: Change history shows who changed which field
expected: Entry shows the user, 'Telefon' and old → new value

criteria.title: GDPR erasure anonymises the contact and removes personal data
expected: Search for the old e-mail finds nothing

modules.name: Workflow-Automatisierung
features: Regeln: Auslöser (Deal-Phase geändert, Kontakt angelegt, Datum) → Bedingungen → Aktionen (Aufgabe, E-Mail, Feld setzen, Webhook)

criteria.title: Automation creates a follow-up task when a deal enters 'Angebot'
steps: Create rule: trigger 'Phase geändert zu Angebot' → action 'Aufgabe: Angebot nachfassen in 3 Tagen'
expected: Deal has task 'Angebot nachfassen' due in 3 days

modules.name: Mehrere Pipelines & Währungen
features: Mehrere Währungen mit Umrechnung in Berichten

criteria.title: Second pipeline with its own stages keeps deals separate
steps: Switch the board to the default pipeline
expected: The partner deal is not shown in the default pipeline

criteria.title: Incoming e-mail from a known address is attached to that contact (test mode)
steps: Inject a test inbound mail from the contact's address via the test-mode sync endpoint
expected: Contact timeline lists the mail with its subject

criteria.title: API key with read scope lists contacts but cannot create them
Winning a deal fires a signed deal.won webhook
steps: Register a webhook for 'deal.won' to the test receiver
expected: Receiver got one POST with event 'deal.won'
Signature header verifies with the webhook secret

criteria.title: Users of organisation A never see data of organisation B
steps: Create a contact in org B
As a user of org A GET /api/contacts and GET /api/contacts/<id of org B contact>
expected: List does not contain the contact

criteria.title: Quota attainment shows won revenue against the target
steps: Set rep A's quota for this month to 20.000

non_functional.text: Alle Listen sind paginiert und serverseitig gefiltert
Responsive bis 375 px Breite; Kanban scrollt horizontal
Listen mit 10.000 Kontakten laden in unter 1 Sekunde (Index auf Suchfeldern)
Barrierefreiheit: Tastaturbedienung der Pipeline, Labels an allen Feldern
Tägliches Backup, Wiederherstellung dokumentiert und getestet
